subject.name: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
subject.subtitle: Feast, September 8
subject.blurb: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary, celebrated September 8, commemorates Mary's birth, an event not recorded in the canonical Gospels but drawn from the second-century Protoevangelium of James, which names her parents as Joachim and Anne. It is one of only three birthdays in the liturgical calendar — alongside Christ's and John the Baptist's — and the date fixes the Immaculate Conception nine months earlier on December 8.
subject.notification: Your birth, O Virgin Mother of God, proclaimed joy to the whole world.
